    The truck

    A sea-serpent on the side, a family at the window.

    You can't miss it: a blue trailer airbrushed with a deep-sea mural, a red-and-blue OPEN neon in the order window, string lights across the top and a turf patio with umbrellas and a fire pit out front.

    It's run by a couple who do it all themselves — [PLACEHOLDER — owners' names & how Athena's started; ask client] — and it shows in the reviews: "very friendly owners," "the couple that run this business are wonderful."

    The name is Athena's, the gods get the burgers, and the gyro meat is a lamb-and-beef blend seasoned with garlic and Greek spices, carved onto a warm pita with house tzatziki. Regulars say the sauce is the secret.
